Justice Prathiba M. Singh
 Justice Amit Sharma
 Order
% 11.12.2024
1.
This hearing has been done through hybrid mode.
CRL.M.A. 37364/2024(for delay)
2. This is an application filed by the Appellant seeking condonation of delay of 50 days in filing the captioned appeal.
3. For the reasons stated in the said application, the delay of 50 days in filing the captioned appeal is condoned.
4. The application is allowed and disposed of accordingly.

5. The present appeal under Section 372 of the CrPC and Section 413 of the BNSS has been filed by the Appellant - XYZ challenging the impugned judgment dated 31st July, 2024 passed by the ld.
ASJ(FTSC) POCSO-01, This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.

The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 14/12/2024 at 01:49:46 West District, Tis Hazari Courts, Delhi in Sessions Case No.178/2022 arising out of FIR No.245/2022, under Sections 323/376/506 of the IPC and Section 6 of the POCSO Act, registered at Xyz vs The State Of Govt. Of Nct Of Delhi & Ors on 11 December, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/13488465/
1 PS Kirti Nagar, by which the Respondent Nos. 3 and 4, who are the accused therein, have been acquitted by the ld. Trial Court on the ground that the prosecution has been unable to establish the foundation facts.
6.
Admit.

7. The Registry is directed to requisition the TCR and prepare the appeal paperbook with proper indexing, pagination and bookmarks expeditiously and provide digitized copies thereof to learned Counsel appearing on behalf of the parties, upon request.
Let the TCR be tagged along with this appeal by the next date of hearing.

8. Issue notice to Respondent Nos. 3 and 4 through the concerned SHO for the next date of hearing.
9.
List on 20th February, 2025.

PRATHIBA M. SINGH, J.
AMIT SHARMA, J.
DECEMBER 11, 2024/nk/Am
